title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Joshua 13: the land still to be taken and the inheritance east of the Jordan for Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell the aged Joshua about the land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Joshua that he was old and that very much land still remained to be possessed.

answers.text: All the land had been taken
Very much land still remained to be possessed
Every nation had made peace with Israel
Israel should go back over the Jordan

questions.text: How many lords of the Philistines does the text mention?
questions.explanation: Among the land that remained, the text names the five lords of the Philistines.

questions.text: Among whom was Joshua told to divide this land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Joshua to divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

answers.text: All twelve tribes in equal shares
Only the priests and the Levites
The nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh
Only the tribes of Judah and Joseph

questions.text: Which peoples did the children of Israel not drive out, so that they still live within Israel?
questions.explanation: Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites; Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

questions.text: According to verse 14, what is the inheritance of the tribe of Levi?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says no inheritance was given to the tribe of Levi; the offerings of Yahweh made by fire are his inheritance.

answers.text: All the land of Gilead and its cities
The city of Heshbon and its villages
The offerings of Yahweh made by fire
The whole kingdom of Og in Bashan

questions.text: Which chiefs of Midian, princes of Sihon, does the text name?
questions.explanation: Moses struck Sihon with the chiefs of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon.

answers.text: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba

questions.text: Which soothsayer did the children of Israel kill with the sword?
questions.explanation: The children of Israel killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword.

questions.text: What was the border of the children of Reuben?
questions.explanation: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan.

answers.text: The shore of the great sea

questions.text: How many cities are the villages of Jair in Bashan said to be?
questions.explanation: Their border included all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

questions.text: For whom were half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei?
questions.explanation: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh.

answers.text: The children of Reuben by their families
The children of Gad by their families
The priests of the tribe of Levi
The children of Machir the son of Manasseh
